post.title: Post
post.description: A scroll, poem, or fragment written in the Whispering Woods Library.

summary.description: Brief description of the whisper's content.

content.description: The full text content. Markdown or HTML supported.

category.description: The category wing where this whisper is shelved.

coverImageURL.description: Optional URL to an image cover scroll.

updatedAt.description: When the whisper was last amended.

likes.description: Count of times this whisper was hearted.

bookmarks.description: Count of times this whisper was bookmarked.

views.description: Count of times this whisper was unfurled.

isDraft.description: Whether the whisper is in draft state and visible only to keepers.

authorSig.description: A signature or pen name of the author.

readTime.description: Estimated time needed to digest the scroll.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: A quiet response or fairy whisper left under a specific post.

postId.description: The ID of the post this comment is tied to.

author.description: Name or pen signature of the commenter.

content.description: The text content of the response.

isWhisper.description: Whether it has a fairycore visual spark.

/posts/{postId}.description: The collection storing all public and draft posts.

/comments/{commentId}.description: A flat collection holding reader responses connected to post IDs.
